name: Kaplak
summary: In Razor Hill, Kaplak trains young orc and troll rogues for the Horde. He teaches stealth, subterfuge, and bladecraft before sending them to Orgrimmar.

sections.title: A Mentor in the Shadows
sections.body: Kaplak trains new Horde rogues in Razor Hill. Orcish custom favors open combat and roaring charges, but he teaches the quieter skills needed to survive: stalking unseen, picking locks, and striking from behind. When his students outgrow his training in Durotar's dusty red ravines, he sends them north to Orgrimmar, where senior guild operatives can deepen their craft.

faq.answer: Kaplak is an orc rogue trainer in Razor Hill, Durotar. He trains young orc and troll rogues from the Valley of Trials in early rogue skills, then sends them to higher trainers in Orgrimmar.
Kaplak can be found in Razor Hill, the central settlement of Durotar. He is usually resting in or around the local barracks with other class trainers.
Kaplak guides rogue adventurers toward advanced trainers and assignments. He may send them to find Therzok in Orgrimmar.

angles.text: As a young orc or troll rogue leaving the Valley of Trials, you can learn your first trade from Kaplak before he directs you to the covert networks in Orgrimmar.
As a member of the Horde, you can count on Kaplak to train scouts, spies, and assassins who guard Durotar and work beyond ordinary battle lines.
